content.short: Wombat is a Web3 gaming platform that connects gamers with Web3 games.
content.description: Wombat, launched in 2019 by a Berlin-based team, is a Web3 gaming platform that helps players discover and play high-quality Web3 titles and interact with NFTs across major blockchains. The app has been downloaded more than 1.5 million times across Android, iOS, and desktop, and is adopted as the preferred login method by more than 70 partner apps, providing a convenient entry point to Web3 games and NFT experiences for a broad audience.
content.meta: Wombat is a Web3 gaming platform that connects gamers with Web3 games and NFT interactions. Discover Wombat and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
